perform.grace: each grace note is a 32nd (1/8 quarter) placed just before the beat of the note it decorates
perform.vel: p 50, f 96, sfp 114 then p, '<' ramps to the next marking; grace notes 14 below the note they decorate
perform.bar: bar 0 is the upbeat (beat 2 of a 2/4 bar); bar and beat follow the performed quarter position q, so a repeat sign closes bar 8 with the next pass's upbeat
perform.kbar: the measure number printed in the kern file; an upbeat carries the number of the bar it completes
perform.art: s staccato, a arpeggiated chord, t trill
perform.sl: s slur starts, e slur ends
